lines.en: If you're watching this, that means I'm already dead.
Life is a -- -How do you know it's gonna be a boy?
-Yesterday, I was scraping some gunk off my wall sockets
with a metal fork, and I gave myself the nastiest shock.
And when I came to, I had an epiphory.
And if I die, I want my son to know the dealio.
-Here are some things that I want to teach you
that your mother won't be able to.
Then you take these bad boys
and clip them anywhere on the engine.
Then you take these and clip them wherever.
Number eight, learn how to take off a woman's bra.
You just twist your hand until something breaks.
And remember, no matter what, I will always love you.
Do you want to do this or no?
